classification.difficultyReason: Find the exterior angle from the supplied interior angle, then use it to calculate the number of sides.

content.prompt:
A regular polygon has a single interior angle as shown.
Work out the number of sides of the regular polygon.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 11, angle diagram below the prompt
spec.description: Two black segments meet at a polygon vertex, with the obtuse interior angle marked by an arc and labelled 156 degrees. No lengths are specified.
spec.mathematics: The marked interior angle is 156 degrees; its supplementary exterior angle is 24 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied interior angle is visible.

answer.worked:
The exterior angle is $180^{\circ}-156^{\circ}=24^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{aligned}n&=\frac{360^{\circ}}{24^{\circ}}\\&=15\end{aligned}$$
The polygon has 15 sides.
